g.text: Single-page probes: every one of 1280 windows retained
Columns: epochs 0–4. Heatmaps: raw 0x34 counts by trial and victim; position=(victim−trial) mod 8.
Repeated preparation is not a reset. Window walk rates are not certified residency probabilities. All single-page counts here are 0 or 1.
